Acceptance: integer/Boolean state exact; activation time exact as float32; exact binary32 IC restoration; up to 2 float32 ULP for accumulator, relief, PI, tank, outflow limits and startup; up to 2 ULP for normal thermal driving, reference initialization and pressure properties; up to 4 ULP for saturated/steam derivatives and isolated/composed loop-transfer outputs, with intermediate traces up to 2 ULP; primary phase/state/flow, heat-capacity and correction stages up to 2 ULP; connected primary core up to 4 ULP with exact phase/latch flags. Alternate decay heat keeps binary64 output and accepts absolute error <= max(1, |reference|) * 2e-13; float32 ULP is not applied to it.

Method and limits
  • Original x86 branches run in Unicorn. COM reads/writes are explicit state; setter callbacks, log formatting and UI cleanup are excluded where documented. Process-birth storage checks compare mapped PE bytes only, before application initialization.
  • Property callees use independently executed prefixes with modeled VB numeric helpers. Accumulator power is modeled with Python libm.
  • Alternate decay heat executes original VB6 Exp/Sqr; loop power executes the original VB6 DLL with a scratch errno cell and explicit x87 53-bit precision; the Windows app precision context has not been established.
  • Windows floating-point context, whole-plant dispatch and original error handling are not replayed.
  • Agreement in these cases is evidence for the translated blocks only; it does not validate complete PCTran scenarios.

Seed: deterministic per fixture. Raw native units: psia, ft³, lb/s, Btu/lb and seconds. JSON contains full inputs and results. Steps are 0–1 s where supplied and event clocks are 0–300 s. These are component updates, not full trajectories. Decay-heat helper boundary probes additionally cover 10000/60000 seconds; original application runs are not extended past its cap.
